label: PS-6(3)
title: Post-employment Requirements

children.label: (a)
children.prose: Notify individuals of applicable, legally binding post-employment requirements for protection of organizational information; and

children.label: (b)
children.prose: Require individuals to sign an acknowledgment of these requirements, if applicable, as part of granting initial access to covered information.

guidance: Organizations consult with the Office of the General Counsel regarding matters of post-employment requirements on terminated individuals.
